forms.name: The Scriptural Rosary
forms.subtitle: One verse of Scripture for every Hail Mary.
forms.detail: A Bible verse for every Hail Mary
forms.about: Each mystery, a scene from the lives of Jesus and Mary, is told verse by verse. The Our Father bead names the mystery and a grace to ask for, each of the Hail Marys has its own verse, and the Glory Be closes it.

forms.name: The Rosary Said Aloud
forms.subtitle: A voice leads every prayer, with no readings between.
forms.about: The beads move with the voice — for praying with the phone put away, or for learning the prayers by ear. Each mystery, a scene from the lives of Jesus and Mary, is announced, and each prayer is shown on the screen as it is said. Pause the voice to pray quietly for a while.

options.name: Meditation Only
options.note: The meditation is read aloud. You say the prayers.

options.name: Whole Rosary
options.note: Every prayer is said aloud. Pray along with the voice.

options.name: Read in Silence
options.note: A verse is shown for each Hail Mary. You read and pray in silence.

options.name: Whole Rosary
options.note: Every verse and prayer is said aloud.

options.name: On My Rosary
options.note: Count on your own rosary. The screen shows one mystery at a time.

options.name: On the Screen
options.note: The beads are on the screen. Swipe for each Hail Mary.
